description: Driver-data sources, keyed by a short stable source id. A source is either LOCAL — a `path` to a sibling repo checked out beside this one, bundled into the app at build time — or FEDERATED, a GitHub `url` the browser fetches live so the library's owner keeps control of it. A driver's unique identity is its source key + its path within that source, never its display name, which can repeat.

winisd-drivers.name: OpenISD
winisd-drivers.description: The driver commons: one openisd.yml record per driver, extracted from manufacturer datasheets and product pages by the winisd_tools pipeline.
winisd-drivers.license: data from manufacturer-published specifications; records CC0
